positive_review_findings: The opt-in profile preserves the legacy default autocast route and its old first-batch normalization path; strict behavior is selected by checkpoint/profile metadata.

Strict fitting requires a campaign split, fixed checkpoint selection, and no evaluation during fit. Campaign membership is loaded and verified before fitting; normalization iterates the ordered fit-valid dataset and records its count and float32 buffer hashes.

Cache inference uses a feature-only SequenceFile read, separates fit membership from output order, validates split/fit/evaluation identities, source hashes, normalization buffers, row order, shape/dtype, finite probability values, and cache bytes.
Strict run directories and cache final paths use create-only behavior with collision tests; failures are not presented as resumable campaign attempts.
